objective: Computation and proof. Dumbbells: a grid, a strip, and a second grid, joined through two 3-edge cuts. Test whether an opened handle in the strip or the second grid creates in the first grid beyond the strip, whether this depends on the strip's length, whether a liquid connector of comparable size screens it, which cut orientation receives it, and whether exact creation confirms it on a small dumbbell.
status: Proved by STRIP-RELAY-20261103-001C-P001 (computation, exact on small dumbbells): in grid-strip-grid dumbbells an opened Fano handle in a rigid strip (two points at every distance up to the far end) or in the far grid creates in the first grid near its cut, at the same four lines for every strip length; a liquid grid connector screens it within three steps and thick tubes relay part of the way; a grid receives only through a cut where it is split at a point and a handle leaves only where its grid lost a line, as a composite handle attached at a line is screened
title: Rigid strips relay a handle
